description: This source file defines a Spring configuration class 'ShareAccountsConfiguration' that registers various beans related to share account management in the Apache Fineract platform. It includes bean definitions for services such as reading share account data, writing share account data, handling dividends, scheduling, and other related operations.

classes.name: ShareAccountsConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that declares beans for share account services, schedulers, and data serializations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: purchasedSharesReadPlatformService
methods.description: Provides an instance of PurchasedSharesReadPlatformService, implementing singleton pattern with conditional bean creation.

methods.name: shareAccountChargeReadPlatformService
methods.description: Provides an instance of ShareAccountChargeReadPlatformService, with conditional creation to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: accountsCommandsService
methods.description: Creates a bean for AccountsCommandsService, specifically for share accounts, with injection of JSON helper and serializer.

methods.name: shareAccountDividendReadPlatformService
methods.description: Provides a service to read share account dividend data, with dependencies on JDBC, validation, pagination, and SQL generator.

methods.name: shareAccountReadPlatformService
methods.description: Creates a read platform service for share accounts, integrating multiple dependencies including product, savings, client, and charge services.

methods.name: shareAccountSchedularService
methods.description: Provides a scheduler service for share accounts, managing dividend processing and account savings.

methods.name: shareAccountWritePlatformService
methods.description: Creates a write platform service for share accounts with data serialization, repositories, API for accounts, journal entries, notes, and event notification.
